comment: zap.c bhitm() 255 and 470-471: a level-30 Priestess learns turn undead and healing from blessed spellbooks. She casts turn undead at a hostile ettin zombie (it usually fails at 90%; the failed tries and the knockback only cost turns), so a successful cast adds spell_damage_bonus() to the undead damage (255). She then forces the creation of Pestilence and casts healing at it; Pestilence always resists, taking half of healamt/2 (470-471).
